name: GPT-6 Cyber
archDisplay: Cyber-specialised post-training of GPT-6 Astra (architecture and size undisclosed); 1.05M-token context (922K max input / 128K max output), text+image in / text out, Responses API only
note: OpenAI's second purpose-trained cybersecurity model, announced November 5, 2026 as `gpt-6-cyber`: a cyber-specialised variant of GPT-6 Astra for authorised vulnerability research, exploit development and security testing, rated Critical in Cybersecurity under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework (GPT-5.6 Cyber was High). GATED LAUNCH: available only to select Daybreak Red customers through the API and Codex, with access expanding over time, so it follows the Gemini 4 Carbon / Argon precedent here: apiAvailable false and price null. The model page already lists $20 input / $2 cached / $100 output per Mtok (standard short-context), to be filed once access is general. Benchmark rows come from the system card's cybersecurity evaluations at the highest tested reasoning budget. Not filed (no corpus column): ExploitGym intended-exploit success 48.45% (Astra 42.43%, GPT-5.6 Cyber 32.1%), ExploitGym Hardened 36.94%, the internal ExploitBench port 42% (V8/Chrome), and Irregular's CyScenarioBench 61% average success.

results.notes: ExploitBench ACE-normalized mean capability score, GPT-6 Cyber system card §7.1 (highest tested reasoning budget). OpenAI caveat: historical vulnerabilities back to 2023 raise a contamination risk that may inflate the result.
SEC-Bench Pro pass@1 (vulnerability discovery in V8 and SpiderMonkey), GPT-6 Cyber system card §7.3; GPT-6 Astra 85.38 on the same chart.
